name: BankID
description: BankID.com (Swedish/Nordic national e-ID) authentication for Drupal. Logs users in via BankID using the externalauth service and the Key module for the RP client certificate + passphrase.
provides_plugin_types: Integration (BankID login/user-provisioning plugin; @Integration annotation in src/Plugin/BankID, manager plugin.manager.bankid.integration)
project_description: The BankID module integrates a Drupal site with the Swedish BankID.com e-identity service (BankID API v6.0) so visitors can log in with their BankID instead of a username and password. It ships a 'Login with BankID' block/form that drives an animated-QR / same-device authentication flow, provisions or matches a Drupal account against the authenticated personnummer via the externalauth module, and stores the relying-party client certificate, its passphrase, and the CA/issuer certificate through the Key module. Test and production environments are configured separately, and the authentication behaviour is pluggable through @Integration plugins (getUser / createUser) so the login can be wired to an external CRM or custom user model.
